feat(codeon): wire System Pi live-e2e preflight probe

Add tools/pi-rpc-compatibility-probe.py --live-smoke so just live-e2e
agent=pi no longer panics in agent_runtime_preflight. The probe env_clears,
probes pi --version, and completes a bounded get_state handshake without
sending a prompt. Document Named Pi as a separate complete layer.
